fields.v: Sample small and illustrative, 'not a comprehensive empirical account'. High-level directives (e.g. 'follow all guidelines for ethical AI') specify no executable conditions, triggers or enforcement; unclear what behaviour agents derive. Open: large-scale mapping of encoded ethical categories; how developers decide and negotiate directives (PRs, mining histories); whether agents adhere (experiments with/without context files); longitudinal evolution; whether machine-oriented representations differ from human codes of conduct; other configuration artefacts (skills, permissions, hooks, system prompts)
